constructor.excluded_from_timer: imports, uninstrumented generation, list/range allocation, explicit GC, instance audit, destruction, power checks, serialization
constructor.failure: stop and preserve records; no automatic retry or outlier removal
constructor.first_configuration: instrumented on even round, uninstrumented on odd round; reset at sample phase
constructor.interpretation: constructor-path cost, including automatic GC and small common loop/storage overhead; difference is not isolated method-binding cost and is never subtracted from formal sort times
constructor.manual_gc: full collection before each batch and after releasing retained objects, outside timer
constructor.point_value_callback: one pre-bound dict.__getitem__, shared by both configurations
constructor.power_checks: before and after every batch; AC Power and lowpowermode 0
constructor.retention: preallocated list retains all batch instances until after timer and checks
constructor.summary: median, R7 quartiles/IQR and range of 50 elapsed_ns/256 observations per configuration; paired difference and ratio; no significance tests
constructor.timed_boundary: constructor calls, loop and preallocated-list assignments; automatic GC may run; no sorting or backend operations

stability.ratio: median(tree elapsed_ns/B) divided by median(list elapsed_ns/B), reconstructed independently for each attempt
stability.scope: post hoc, outside preregistered protocol, descriptive stability only; no merging, resampling, significance tests, causal claims or changes to main 302-input statistics
stability.selection: all inputs in sources COMPLETE in the first attempt; exclude partial geometric and all seeded
summaries: ratio median and range by attempt
absolute relative ratio change in percent
